ops.title: Require structural performance fixes across tooling campaign
ops.body: User decision Nov15: make recurring expensive cases structurally impossible with proper abstractions and engineering, for every fix moving forward. Centralize data ownership and invariants; choose bounded algorithms and indexed read models; remove superseded paths. Add regression checks for the performance property, not just output. Do not accumulate per-call caches, retries, limits or guards as substitutes for the root fix. Applies to dashboard, CCN, Capt, CCI, CCX and held campaign work. Root owns enforcement through implementation, review, release, installation and natural affected-case measurement. Existing acceptance criteria and session protections remain.
